Figure 1: Why compressors matter. Many agentic LM systems rely on compressors, and personal devices are growing powerful enough to host them. (Left) A compressor condenses a long input X into a shorter summary Z, which a predictor ingests to extract the final answer У, (Right) Consumer hardware can now run increasingly large open-weight LMs, shown for Google Pixel phones and Apple MacBook laptops under FP16 precision with memory estimates from Modal |38|]. LM-Arena ranks indicate relative performance.
